changeSet.comment: Remap viz aggregation bucket fields from event.* (flat_object, not aggregatable) and stale log.* to the new typed utm.* bag so chart dimensions aggregate. Only the aggregation column is touched; filters/query are left alone (flat_object search is fine there). Idempotent: LIKE-guarded REPLACE matches nothing once migrated.
